summary.headline: Mercury in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Chapter 44 interprets Mercury in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and Venus, associating these placements with speech, suspicion, royal friendship, deception, learning, memory, profound sciences, friendship, and lasciviousness; the preceding lines conclude Venus’s indications in the Moon’s house and movable signs.
